3 Attacks.note: On the Po after it chooses no one, until it takes three kills.

setupPrep.none: its tokens are only used after the first night or when something happens

reminderMovement.why: Marks tonight’s deaths or attacks, placed anew each time.

reminderPlaceholders.note: One kill, or no kill and 3 Attacks; after a charge, 3 kills.

full.text: If the Po chose no one last night (*3 ATTACKS*), remove it: the Po chooses 3 players, mark each *DEAD*. Otherwise the Po may choose a player (mark them *DEAD*) or no one (mark the Po *3 ATTACKS*).
full.reason: Says when the 3 Attacks token goes on and comes off.
